note: Huron NF in the village of Sand Lake near National City: a rustic, wooded campground in two loops on 91-acre Round Lake, which is mostly ringed by private land (the campground is the only public access). About a quarter of the sites have water access; sandy beach and a gravel boat ramp; garbage service. Groceries and fuel nearby. --Claude
